guidelines.title: charts start with story
guidelines.rule: Start with the story, not the chart. Pick the relationship (comparison, trend, proportion, distribution, correlation) first. No chart if a single callout number or a table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart needs heavy explanation. Not for decoration.
pass_when: Chart type matches the relationship; no chart when a callout or table is clearer, the set is too small, or it needs heavy explanation.
fail_when: Decorative chart; chart for a single number that a callout would carry.

guidelines.title: honest baseline bars zero or truncation
guidelines.rule: Honest baseline: bars start at zero or show truncation. Meaningful scales, consistent time intervals, readable labels. Don’t rotate labels to hide a truncated axis.
pass_when: Bars start at zero, or truncation is shown; scales/intervals are consistent; labels are not rotated to hide a truncated axis.
fail_when: Truncated bar axis with no truncation mark; labels rotated to hide it.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Keep-text-horizontal min px as this baseline row.

guidelines.title: chart anatomy title insight table
guidelines.rule: Required anatomy: title (timeframe + unit) + insight summary + data table. Subtitle or callout, not both. Summary states what the data means (“requests rose from 220 to 420”), not “the line goes up.” Small datasets: full semantic table visible, not behind a toggle. Medium: summarised table. Large: summary + download of source.
pass_when: Title includes timeframe + unit; insight says what the data means; small sets show a visible semantic table; subtitle and callout are not both used.
fail_when: No table for a small set (or table only behind a toggle); summary is “the line goes up”; title omits unit/timeframe.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Tooltip-only values as this anatomy row.

guidelines.title: direct labels over legends
guidelines.rule: Direct labels over legends; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices; doughnut preferred in digital. Legend only when direct labels fail; keep it readable at 200% zoom. Stacked bar: 3–4 segments. Multi-line: 3–4 series. Horizontal bar when category labels are long.
pass_when: Direct labels where they fit; pie/doughnut 2–4 slices (doughnut preferred on digital); stacked bar / multi-line 3–4; long categories use horizontal bar.
fail_when: Legend as the only labels when direct labels would fit; pie with many slices; many stacked segments or lines.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house choice-cutoff for form controls.

guidelines.title: no tooltip only values
guidelines.rule: No tooltip-only values — hover is not the values channel (keyboard/touch/AT). Dual-cite empty/failure “don’t hide the only message in a dismissible overlay.”
pass_when: Values are available without hover (labels, table, or equivalent).
fail_when: The only values are in a hover tooltip.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Chart anatomy table as a substitute that drops this hover ban.

guidelines.title: 100pct stacked show absolute totals
guidelines.rule: 100% stacked bars must show absolute totals — percentages hide count; give the total per category so scale is judgeable.
pass_when: 100% stacked bars include the absolute total per category.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Honest zero baseline as this totals row.

guidelines.title: lines dash fills patterns
guidelines.rule: Lines use dash styles; fills use patterns (max 4–5). Solid / dashed / dotted / dash-dot for series. Hatch/dot/grid for bars, area, pie — not for lines. Two colours per pattern (fill + stroke).
pass_when: Line series use dash styles; area/bar/pie fills use patterns (≤4–5) with two colours per pattern; patterns are not used on lines.
fail_when: Line series distinguished only by colour with no dash; patterns on lines; more than 5 fill patterns.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Established colour conventions as a merge that drops dash/pattern.

guidelines.title: chart text horizontal
guidelines.rule: Keep chart text horizontal; long categories → horizontal bar, don’t rotate. If a tool forces rotation, cap 45° and keep ≥12px at all viewports. Min sizes: title 16–18px, data labels 12px, notes 11–12px. Y-axis labels right-aligned; X centred. Commas in thousands; no digit spaces (AT).
pass_when: Labels stay horizontal (or ≤45° if the tool forces rotation, ≥12px); long categories use a horizontal bar; thousands use commas not spaces.
fail_when: Rotated labels to avoid a horizontal bar; digit spaces in thousands.

guidelines.title: white canvas single colour when labelled
guidelines.rule: White canvas; single colour when bars are already labelled. `#FFFFFF`. Multi-colour only for multiple series or a highlight. Approved NSW / Aboriginal chart-mark palettes only (pre-validated on white). Start with theme 01 then 02.
pass_when: Chart sits on white; labelled single-series bars use one colour; extra colours only for series or highlight; NSW/Aboriginal palettes only.
fail_when: Non-white canvas; rainbow single-series labelled bars; unapproved palette.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Established conventions (next row) as a free-for-all palette.

guidelines.title: established colour conventions
guidelines.rule: Established colour conventions override the theme palette — traffic light risk, party colours, water/vegetation, finance red/black. Still label/pattern so colour is not the only channel. Do not generalize the exception.
pass_when: Domain conventions (risk/party/land/finance) override theme; colour is not the only channel.
fail_when: Theme palette used where a named convention applies, or colour is the only channel.

guidelines.title: maps never only channel
guidelines.rule: Maps are never the only channel — text-based alternative always. Aspect ratio must differ from the viewport so mobile users can still scroll the page; leave space around the map and a close/minimise control.
pass_when: A text alternative exists; map aspect ratio is not the full viewport; close/minimise and space around the map exist.
fail_when: Map is the only channel; map fills the viewport so the page cannot scroll.

guidelines.title: map pan from centre select jumps listing
guidelines.rule: Map pan updates from centre; select centres the marker and jumps the listing. Popup snapshot + further-info link; dismiss via close and when another point is selected. Overlapping points → cluster. Filter labels name the input (postcode / suburb / full address).
pass_when: Pan is from centre; selecting a point centres it and moves the listing; popup has a further-info link and dismisses on close or next select; overlaps cluster; filter labels name the input.
fail_when: Select does not update the listing; overlapping points unclustered; unnamed filter inputs.

guidelines.title: privacy by design pia security day one
guidelines.rule: Privacy by design + PIA; security from day one — named NSW Design Standards. Complete and maintain a Privacy Impact Assessment; consent and data-use are explicit; identifiable vs de-identified access is separated. Security is designed and tested from the first release, not bolted on. Dual-cite USWDS earn-trust / data stewardship without merging the PIA/security-from-day-one names.
pass_when: A maintained PIA exists; consent/data-use are explicit; identifiable vs de-identified access is separated; security is in the first release.
fail_when: No PIA; security bolted on after launch; identifiable and de-identified access mixed.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Generic “be accessible”; USWDS design-principle slogans as this PIA row.
